decisions.reason: As a newly launched carpet in an expanding market, it still has option value and there is no clear negative signal yet to justify an early withdrawal.
The premium hand-knotted wool silk positioning is somewhat riskier and narrower, but after only one year its market potential is still too uncertain to close the option.
Although it overlaps with other carpet introductions and may face internal substitution, the firm would usually allow more time before judging a recent design product unsuccessful.
The corner bench fits the firm's core interior offering and can serve both private and project customers, so keeping it on the market preserves a plausible growth option at low additional cost.
This low-pile carpet faces portfolio crowding from similar launches, which raises its exit risk somewhat, but not enough to outweigh the value of waiting for more market feedback.
The swivel shell chair aligns well with the firm's move toward flexible workplace and contemporary living concepts, so management would be inclined to continue and learn from the market.
